operations.name: comp.create
operations.description: Create a new composition.

operations.name: comp.set_label
operations.description: Set label color on comps. Can target by name, id, or pattern (e.g. 'review_id_*').

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or pattern with '*' wildcard

operations.name: comp.set_props
operations.description: Set composition properties (bgColor, workAreaStart, workAreaDuration, shutterAngle, motionBlur, etc.).

operations.name: comp.set_renderer
operations.description: Switch a comp's 3D renderer: classic3d | advanced3d | cinema4d (or a raw matchName from comp.list_renderers). Advanced 3D is required for 3D model layers, parametric meshes, and environment lights to render.

params.name: renderer
params.description: classic3d|advanced3d|cinema4d, or an exact renderer matchName

operations.name: comp.list_renderers
operations.description: List the comp's available 3D renderer matchNames, the current one, and the friendly-name mapping used by comp.set_renderer.

operations.name: comp.set_work_area
operations.description: Set the work area start and duration on a composition.

operations.name: comp.add_guide
operations.description: Add a horizontal or vertical guide line to a comp (AE 16.1+).

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

operations.name: comp.remove_guide
operations.description: Remove a guide from a comp by its 0-based index (see comp.list_guides).

operations.name: comp.set_guide
operations.description: Move an existing guide to a new position (Item.setGuide). Orientation cannot be changed after creation — remove and re-add instead.

params.name: position
params.description: New position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

operations.name: comp.list_guides
operations.description: List all guides on a comp with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

operations.name: comp.delete
operations.description: Delete a composition from the project.

operations.name: comp.precompose
operations.description: Pre-compose selected layers into a new nested composition.

params.name: layerIndices
params.description: Array of 1-based layer indices to precompose

params.name: moveAll
params.description: Move all attributes into new comp (default true)

operations.name: comp.duplicate
operations.description: Duplicate a composition.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name or id to duplicate

operations.name: comp.info
operations.description: Comp details + per-layer summaries (same payload as ae_comp_info). As a batch.run child, lets the same call verify what a preceding mutation did.

operations.name: layer.create_solid
operations.description: Create a solid layer in a composition.

operations.name: layer.create_shape
operations.description: Create an empty shape layer.

operations.name: layer.create_text
operations.description: Create a text layer: point text by default, paragraph (box) text when boxSize is given, vertical when orientation='vertical' (AE 24.2+). Point<->box conversion is not scriptable, so pick the right kind here.

params.name: boxSize
params.description: [width, height] — creates paragraph (box) text instead of point text

params.name: boxPosition
params.description: [x, y] top-left of the box in layer space (box text only)

operations.name: layer.create_null
operations.description: Create a null object layer.

operations.name: layer.create_camera
operations.description: Create a camera layer.

operations.name: layer.create_light
operations.description: Create a light layer.

operations.name: layer.create_parametric_mesh
operations.description: Create a parametric 3D mesh layer (LayerCollection.addParametricMesh, AE 26.3+): cube|sphere|plane|cylinder|cone|torus. Best rendered with the Advanced 3D renderer (comp.set_renderer).

operations.name: layer.delete
operations.description: Delete layers. comp supports pattern ('review_id_*'). layer supports index, name, 'selected', 'all'.

operations.name: layer.duplicate
operations.description: Duplicate a layer. Returns the new layer's index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.set_parent
operations.description: Set or clear a layer's parent. By default AE compensates the child's transform so it doesn't move; jump=true skips compensation (setParentWithJump) so the child adopts the parent's space.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based child layer index, or the layer name

params.name: parentLayer
params.description: 1-based parent layer index or name. Pass null or 0 to unparent.

params.name: jump
params.description: true = no transform compensation (setParentWithJump). Default false.

operations.name: layer.scene_edit_detection
operations.description: Run Scene Edit Detection on a video layer (Layer.doSceneEditDetection, AE 22.3+): find cuts in edited footage and mark or split at them.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: mode
params.description: markers (add layer markers) | split (split layer) | splitPrecomp (split + precompose each) | none (detect only)

operations.name: layer.move
operations.description: Move a layer to a new stacking position (1 = top).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based current layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.create_footage
operations.description: Add an existing project item (footage or comp) as a layer in a composition.

params.name: sourceItemId
params.description: Project item id to use as source

operations.name: layer.set_enabled
operations.description: Enable or disable a layer by name or index. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

operations.name: layer.set_guide
operations.description: Set guideLayer on/off for a layer. Can target all comps matching a pattern.

params.name: comp
params.description: Comp name/id, or '*' for all comps, or 'review_id_*' for pattern match

operations.name: layer.set_props
operations.description: Set basic layer properties. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. Enum-valued attributes accept string names: quality (best|draft|wireframe), samplingQuality (bilinear|bicubic), frameBlendingType (off|frameMix|pixelMotion), autoOrient (off|alongPath|cameraOrPointOfInterest|charactersTowardCamera), blendingMode, lightType (spot|parallel|point|ambient|environment).

params.name: props
params.description: Object with keys to set, e.g. { name: 'foo', enabled: false, label: 5, threeDLayer: true }

operations.name: layer.add_guide
operations.description: Add a ruler guide to a layer's Layer panel view (Layer.addGuide, AE 16.1+). Comp-panel guides live under comp.add_guide.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: position
params.description: Position in px (y for horizontal, x for vertical)

operations.name: layer.remove_guide
operations.description: Remove a Layer-panel ruler guide by its 0-based index (see layer.list_guides).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.move_guide
operations.description: Move an existing Layer-panel ruler guide to a new position (Layer.setGuide). Named move_guide because layer.set_guide already means the guide-LAYER flag.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.list_guides
operations.description: List a layer's Layer-panel ruler guides with orientation and position (AE 16.1+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.bounds
operations.description: Measure a layer's rendered bounds via sourceRectAtTime — essential for aligning/fitting text and shape layers. Returns layer-space rect and, when the host supports it, comp-space corners.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds (default: current comp time)

params.name: includeExtents
params.description: Include pixel extents beyond the layer edges (default false)

operations.name: layer.convert_point
operations.description: Convert a point between layer source space and comp space (sourcePointToComp / compPointToSource, AE 13.2+; designed for text layers — evaluates at the first character at the given time).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Evaluate at this time (default: current comp time)

operations.name: layer.apply_preset
operations.description: Apply an animation preset (.ffx file) to a layer — applies effects/keyframes in one call.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.replace_source
operations.description: Replace a layer's source with another project item (footage or comp), keeping keyframes/effects. Set fixExpressions=false to skip expression rewriting.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: item
params.description: New source: project item id (number) or name (string)

params.name: fixExpressions
params.description: Rewrite expressions that reference the old source (default true)

operations.name: layer.set_track_matte
operations.description: Set (or remove) a track matte on a layer. Uses AVLayer.setTrackMatte (AE 23.0+): the matte can be ANY layer in the comp — it does not need to sit directly above the target.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based index (or name) of the layer to apply matte TO

params.name: matteLayer
params.description: Matte source layer: 1-based index or name. Ignored when matteType is 'none'.

operations.name: layer.set_blend_mode
operations.description: Set blending mode on a layer.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: layer.split
operations.description: Split a layer at a given time. Creates a new layer that starts at the split time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: Time in seconds to split at

operations.name: layer.copy_to_comp
operations.description: Copy a layer from one comp to another.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index (or name) in source comp

operations.name: layer.calculate_transform
operations.description: Calculate the transform that maps a 3D layer onto three corner points (AVLayer.calculateTransformFromPoints) - corner-pin style placement in 3D space. Calculation-only: returns anchorPoint/position/x-y-zRotation/scale without touching the layer — apply them with property.set / layer.set_props.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name (3D layer)

params.name: topLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the layer's top-left

params.name: bottomLeft
params.description: [x,y,z] world point for the bottom-left. The scripting guide names this pointBottomRight, but the implementation expects the bottom-left (the guide's own example passes bl): a true bottom-right returns the same placement with zScale skewed by sin(corner angle) — verified on AE 26.3.

operations.name: layer.info
operations.description: Full layer info incl. property trees and keyframes (same payload as ae_layer_info). Layer by 1-based index or name. includeProperties=false for the cheap summary.

params.name: includeProperties
params.description: Walk the full property tree (default true)

operations.name: transform.set
operations.description: Set transform properties on one or more layers. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'. For keyframes use keyframe.add.

operations.name: keyframe.add
operations.description: Add a keyframe at a specific time with a value.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.remove
operations.description: Remove a keyframe by its 1-based index.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_easing
operations.description: Apply easing to a keyframe. Preset: 'linear', 'ease', 'easeIn', 'easeOut', 'hold'. Or custom bezier with inSpeed/outSpeed/inInfluence/outInfluence.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_batch
operations.description: Set many keyframes on one property in a single call (Property.setValuesAtTimes). times and values must have the same length.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.shift
operations.description: Retime all keyframes on a property: newTime = (time - pivot) * scale + pivot + offset. Preserves interpolation, ease, and spatial tangents best-effort.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: pivot
params.description: Pivot time in seconds for scaling (default 0)

operations.name: keyframe.copy
operations.description: Copy all keyframes from one property to another (same or different layer/comp). Value types must be compatible. Existing target keys are kept.

params.name: targetProperty
params.description: Target property path (default: same as source)

params.name: timeOffset
params.description: Seconds to add to every copied key time (default 0)

operations.name: keyframe.set_spatial
operations.description: Set spatial tangents / continuity on a keyframe of a spatial property (Position, Anchor Point). Tangents are [x,y] or [x,y,z] offsets.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_roving
operations.description: Set a keyframe to rove across time (smooth speed on a spatial path). First and last keyframes cannot rove.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_value
operations.description: Change the value of an existing keyframe without changing its time.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_interpolation
operations.description: Set a keyframe's in/out interpolation types directly (linear|bezier|hold — asymmetric combinations allowed, e.g. bezier in / hold out), and the temporal continuous / auto-bezier flags. For speed/influence curves use keyframe.set_easing.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: temporalAutoBezier
params.description: Temporal auto-bezier flag (true also enables continuity)

operations.name: keyframe.set_label
operations.description: Set a keyframe's label color (Property.setLabelAtKey, AE 22.6+).

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: keyframe.set_selected
operations.description: Select or deselect keyframes on a property (Property.setSelectedAtKey) - e.g. to stage keys for a user-facing copy/paste in the UI.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: expression.set
operations.description: Apply an expression to a property.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: expression.disable_all
operations.description: Disable all expressions in a comp (all layers, all properties). Returns a manifest that can be used to re-enable them later via expression.restore_all. Manifest paths use numeric property indices; manifests produced by older versions of this operation (matchName-based paths) are not compatible.

operations.name: expression.restore_all
operations.description: Re-enable expressions from a manifest produced by expression.disable_all. Optionally transform the expressions before restoring (e.g. replace content variable). Only manifests in the current format (numeric property-index paths) are supported; manifests from older versions are not compatible.

params.name: replacements
params.description: Optional string replacements to apply to each expression before restoring, e.g. { "old": "new" }

operations.name: expression.remove
operations.description: Remove (disable) the expression on a property.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: property.set
operations.description: Set any layer property by path. layer can be index, name, 'selected', or 'all'.

operations.name: property.get
operations.description: Get the current value of any layer property by path.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: time
params.description: If set, get value at this time (for animated properties)

operations.name: property.list
operations.description: List child properties/groups at a given path. Useful for discovering what's inside a property group.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Property path to a group. Use [] for the layer root.

operations.name: property.add
operations.description: Add a property to an indexed group by matchName (PropertyGroup.addProperty). Unlocks text animators ('ADBE Text Animator' on ["Text","Animators"]), layer styles, shape contents, etc. Use property.list to discover group paths.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the group to add into, e.g. ["Text","Animators"]. Use [] for layer root.

params.name: matchName
params.description: Match name (or display name) of the property to add, e.g. "ADBE Text Animator". NOTE: adding to an indexed group re-creates it, invalidating prior property references.

operations.name: property.remove
operations.description: Remove a property or group by path (Property.remove). Works on members of indexed groups: effects, masks, shape contents, text animators, layer styles.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to remove

operations.name: property.separate_dimensions
operations.description: Separate (or rejoin) the dimensions of a multi-dimensional property such as Position. When separated, animate the followers (e.g. X Position) individually.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

operations.name: property.move
operations.description: Reorder a property within its parent INDEXED group (PropertyBase.moveTo): masks, shape contents, text animators. For effects use effect.move.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name

params.name: property
params.description: Path to the property to move (a member of an indexed group)

params.name: toIndex
params.description: 1-based target position within the parent group

operations.name: property.select
operations.description: Select or deselect a property in the timeline (PropertyBase.selected) - stages it for UI-side actions and makes it visible with the U-shortcut workflow.

params.name: layer
params.description: 1-based layer index, or the layer name
